story.heading: Our Story
story.p1: Founded in 2019, Pixelarium began as a small online gallery showcasing emerging digital artists. Today, we are a thriving marketplace connecting artists with collectors worldwide.
story.p2: Our mission is to make digital art accessible, discoverable, and collectible. We believe every pixel tells a story.
